label: Bible Study
prompt: Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of _____.
verse: Man that is born of a woman is of few days, and full of trouble.
note: Job's sober math on the human condition — short on days, long on trouble.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And said, O man greatly _____, fear not: peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.
verse: And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.
note: A heavenly visitor touches trembling Daniel: O man greatly beloved, fear not — be strong, yea, be strong.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the _____ with his couch into the midst before Jesus.
verse: And when they could not find by what way they might bring him in because of the multitude, they went upon the housetop, and let him down through the tiling with his couch into the midst before Jesus.
note: Luke's version of the roof story: the friends lowered the sick man through the tiling, couch and all, right before Jesus.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Behold, the nations are as a drop of a _____, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.
verse: Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.
note: The nations are like a drop from a bucket and dust on the scales — not even worth weighing.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: My son, if sinners _____ thee, consent thou not.
verse: My son, if sinners entice thee, consent thou not.
note: Solomon's first fatherly warning is short and sweet: if sinners 'entice' thee, consent thou not.
